text: {"question":"How did the assessment of early dark energy models relative to models that increase the effective number of relativistic species change between the earlier and later studies?","reference_answer":"The earlier study found early dark energy to be the most effective at easing the Hubble tension, while the later study highlighted that models increasing Neff can also reduce the tension to 2–3σ, indicating a shift toward considering Neff‑enhancing scenarios as competitive alternatives."}
